candidate_program.name: bounded_neighbor_redundancy_discount
candidate_program.rationale: Gives a limited count discount when active competitors conflict with each other, plus a small relative-reward adjustment. One-hop density cannot resolve the witness; neighbor-edge enumeration may be quadratic in degree.
candidate_program.rule: weight / (1 + degree * (1 - 0.15 * neighbor_edge_density)) * (1 + 0.05 * weight / (1 + weight + conflict_weight))

comparison: exact rational comparison of returned binary float scores
cost_scope: Cached offline score-fit evaluation only; does not replace complete-schedule charged cost
